maria-ops: quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem. consolidating remediation items into a short sprint before next DR run. drop ETAs here. main problems: multi-region routing flaps, restore runbook gaps, snapshot verification failures.
aj-sre: taking A1 (routing stabilization + DNS checks). canary in eu-west Tue -> roll Wed. ETA Wed EOD.
samir-ml: recurring KV rebuilds after failover; proposing TTL alignment + jitter + warmers. drafting RFC today.
dee-eng: A2 (backup validation): found S3 lifecycle tag mismatch in us-east. revalidation Thu; add automated smoke restore if green. ETA Fri.

aj-sre: will review PR. keep BGP prep optional with clear warning about propagation.
opsbot: Reminder: DR rehearsal scheduled 2024-11-12 15:00 UTC. channels: #game-day #oncall. runbook v2.1.
dee-eng: blocker: need temp access to validation cluster for smoke restore. @karen-platform can you grant until Fri?
karen-platform: granted temp role to dee-eng until Fri; added IAM checklist item.
maria-ops: action matrix paste: A1 owner aj-sre patch & canary Tue -> roll Wed; A2 owner dee-eng revalidation Thu -> smoke Fri; A3 owner karen-platform PR -> review today -> merge by Thu; A4 owner samir-ml RFC today -> rollout next week.

opsbot: Note: runbook v2.2 deployed to internal wiki.
maria-ops: reconvene Fri 16:00 UTC for status huddle. update ETAs by EOD Thu if anything changes. I'll compile game day feedback into follow-up doc.
aj-sre: :thumbsup:
dee-eng: smoke restore logs will be uploaded to /backups/smoke-logs/3412345678
